title: Deterministic stage-0 triage + combined review pipeline
label_source: none for the 1,546 (descriptive); synthetic degradation labels for rule derivation; human gold for validation
protocol: Stage-0 rules over cached descriptor features, fixed a priori, validated on 6-window-per-degradation synthetics and on the 150 human gold windows; applied to the 1,546 review windows. No decode.

gold_validation.note: n is tiny (rules fire on 2%% of gold): treat as indicative only; the funnel certification found NO safe quality-reject rule on gold

base_frozen_policy.rule: score>=0.75 accept / <=0.25 reject / else review (symmetric band)

a_gating_alone.rule: decide top-45% by cost-margin, review rest

b_plus_stage0.rule: a) + deterministic quality REJECT on review windows

c_plus_calibration.rule: b) + gold-LOCO temperature on the score
c_plus_calibration.note: monotone transform: review share unchanged; it only shifts the accept/reject split (measured on gold, not on the 1,546)

honesty: Stage-0 fires on only ~2.5%% of the 1,546 windows and the fired windows have NO labels, so the review reduction it buys is a descriptive count, not a measured accuracy. On the 150 gold windows the rules fire 3 times (precision_bad 0.67, n=3): the funnel's own certification found no safe quality-reject rule.
